description: Defines constants, enums, and functions related to cookie attributes and policies in the Chromium project, including cookie priorities, SameSite policies, enforcement modes, and port ranges.
external_methods: NET_EXPORT CookieSameSite StringToCookieSameSite(const std::string& same_site, CookieSameSiteString* samesite_string)

classes.name: CookieSameSite
classes.description: Enumeration of allowed SameSite attribute values for cookies.

classes.name: CookieSameSiteForMetrics
classes.description: Enumeration of SameSite values used specifically for metrics.

classes.name: CookieEffectiveSameSite
classes.description: Enumeration of enforcement modes for cookie SameSite policies.

classes.name: CookieSameSiteString
classes.description: Enumeration of string representations of SameSite attribute states for metrics.

classes.name: CookieAccessSemantics
classes.description: Enumeration of semantics for cookie access rules.

classes.name: CookieSourceScheme
classes.description: Enumeration of schemes used in setting cookies.

classes.name: CookiePort
classes.description: Enumeration of port numbers used in cookies for histogram purposes.

classes.name: CookieAccessScheme
classes.description: Enumeration of trust schemes for cookie access.

classes.name: CookieSourceSchemeName
classes.description: Enumeration of scheme names for setting cookies.

classes.name: TruncatingCharacterInCookieStringType
classes.description: Enumeration of characters that can cause cookie string truncation.

methods.name: CookiePriorityToString
methods.description: Converts a CookiePriority enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToCookiePriority
methods.description: Parses a string to a CookiePriority enum.

methods.name: CookieSameSiteToString
methods.description: Converts a CookieSameSite enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToCookieSameSite
methods.description: Parses a string to a CookieSameSite enum, optionally returning the string type.

methods.name: RecordCookieSameSiteAttributeValueHistogram
methods.description: Records a histogram value for the CookieSameSite attribute.

methods.name: ReducePortRangeForCookieHistogram
methods.description: Reduces a port number to a histogram bucketed value.

methods.name: GetSchemeNameEnum
methods.description: Returns the scheme name enum for a given URL.
